description.value: Oldhand Coffee is a family-owned specialty cafe and bakery in downtown Abbotsford, rooted in European traditions of hospitality and community. Everything is baked in-house daily using local and seasonal ingredients, with a full espresso bar and a rotating menu of pastries, sandwiches, and sweets. A second location opened in Langley in March 2025, and the Abbotsford cafe has become a well-established downtown social hub.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a legitimate specialty cafe and bakery with locations in Abbotsford (2617 Pauline St) and Langley — the OSM coordinates (49.0493921, -122.2915255) align with Abbotsford, not Chilliwack as tagged in OSM. The menu page explicitly labels several items as '(gf + vegan)' and '(gf)', confirming dietary options; the cafe/bakery model and shop page confirm takeout. No website content addresses bike facilities, washrooms, water refill, or wi-fi, so those are marked null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but website and coordinates place this business in Abbotsford (2617 Pauline St); the record should be reassigned to the Abbotsford community.
OSM name 'Oldhand Cafe and Bakery' does not match the business's own branding 'Oldhand Coffee' used consistently across the website, domain, and Instagram (@oldhandcoffee).
Phone number +1-778-779-3111 from OSM could not be verified — no phone number appears anywhere in the scraped website content.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 07:00-20:00; Sa 08:00-20:00; Su 08:00-17:00) conflict with website hours (7am-5pm Mon-Fri, 8am-5pm Sat-Sun); website version appears more current.
